title: English Practice Quiz 0932
description: A ten-question English practice quiz covering grammar, vocabulary and practical communication.

questions.question: A good team leader should set ___.
questions.explanation: Clear expectations help team members understand their responsibilities.

questions.question: Delegation means ___.
options: assigning responsibility or tasks to others appropriately
questions.explanation: Delegation distributes work while the leader remains accountable for oversight.

questions.question: A leader who welcomes suggestions demonstrates ___.
questions.explanation: Welcoming suggestions encourages participation and improvement.

questions.question: When a team member performs well, a leader should ___.
A team leader should address poor performance by ___.
options: discussing specific concerns and support needed
questions.explanation: Specific feedback and support make improvement more achievable.

questions.question: Leading by example means ___.
options: demonstrating the standards expected from the team
asking others to follow rules you ignore
questions.explanation: A leader's behaviour should reflect the standards they expect.

questions.question: A team objective is most effective when it is ___.
options: understood and shared by team members
questions.explanation: Shared objectives help align team effort.

questions.question: A leader should make decisions using ___.
questions.explanation: Facts and fair judgement support sound decisions.

questions.question: Coaching at work focuses on helping an employee ___.
When a team faces a setback, a constructive leader should ___.
options: review the cause and agree on next steps
questions.explanation: A review helps the team learn and recover.
